info.name: Razorpay Bills X Account Validation API

params.name: from
params.description: Unix timestamp. Only validations created from this timestamp onwards are returned.

params.name: to
params.description: Unix timestamp. Only validations created before this timestamp are returned.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of validation records to return. Default: 10. Maximum: 100.

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of validation records to skip. Use for pagination. Default: 0.

items.docs: List all fund account validation records, optionally filtered by date range.

info.name: Validate a bank account or VPA

items.docs: Three validation methods: (1) penny drop for bank accounts — sends Re.1 to verify; (2) penny drop for VPA — sends Re.1 to UPI address; (3) reverse penny drop — sends UPI intent URL to customer who initiates payment. Live-mode only, RazorpayX Lite account required. Composite validation (creates Contact + Fund Account inline) supported via validation_type field.

params.name: validation_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the fund account validation (e.g. `fav_00000000000001`).

items.docs: Fetch details of a specific fund account validation by its ID.
